reviews.title: Too many ads
reviews.text: Even as a paying subscriber, I am inundated with ads. The ad density is extremely high, which makes reading not fun.

reviews.title: I was wrong! A version that still fails!!!
reviews.text: Version 8.0.0 is not working on older iPhone iOS 17.7.

reviews.title: Horrible on older iPhone!! Unusable
reviews.text:
No margins / text to the edge:there is no padding so text runs right to the very edge of the screen.

Last several “improvements“ have caused nightmare stalls, freezes, sluggish, unresponsive unusable behavior. Horrible! Why should I be paying for an unusable app? Totally craptastic app now. Not all of us are rich.

There should be a way to go back to much earlier versions that worked better.

reviews.title: Impossible to use
reviews.text: Great content but the app is so glitchy, you can’t enjoy the articles. Ever since the last update, I can’t scroll through the articles. It’s like the app is continually trying to load ads. I want a refund in my subscription

reviews.title: Stops scrolling
reviews.text: The content is fine but the phone app no longer scrolls properly.  I am no longer able to finish reading any articles.  The update did not solve the problem.

reviews.title: Speak article
reviews.text: For those of us who cannot read, it would be really helpful if The Atlantic had a read aloud feature posted at the top of each charitable

reviews.title: Complicit with genocide
reviews.text: I liked some of the journalism but ultimately had to cancel my subscription as this news source seems to want to be complicit with genocide.

reviews.title: Skips around while you’re reading.
reviews.text: This app is horrible. I’m trying to read a very long and interesting article but I’ve been moved around twice now. Once to the middle of the article and now again with a push to write a review! Thanks for ruining my reading experience. Here’s your review. Hope you like it. Now maybe I can finish reading my article in peace.

reviews.title: Great content, extremely bad display of comments
reviews.text: Great magazine and content but try entering a comment in the app. The app has extreme trouble in terms of not displaying portions of the text, mangles half of the text horizontally, fails to display words. This has happened across multiple devices old and new, multiple iOS versions.

reviews.title: Games leaving so I am as well
reviews.text: Had the app because you needed it for the games. They just announced Stacks is being discontinued so I am leaving as well.

reviews.title: Still the worst app on my phone :-(
reviews.text: 10 app updates in the last month…and still problems persist! At what point do you just fire the developer for incompetence and find someone else to fix these issues? Y’all need to do better. How am I supposed to enjoy your wonderful journalism if your app can’t deliver it?!

reviews.title: Great content. Infuriating app
reviews.text: This is only app that consistently logs you out and then, after logging back in, does not recognize my paid subscription and will not let me read an article. What am I paying for? Fix this problem!!! It’s been plaguing this app for more than a year

reviews.title: Woke and Whiney
reviews.text:
Disappointed by the constant bias
I subscribed looking forward to good long reads on Sundays. Instead I’ve found almost every article heavily left-leaning, with an unusually large number focused on criticizing Trump. As an independent who actually wants to hear both sides, the one-sided coverage is incredibly annoying.

reviews.title: Good Magazine, terrible subscription support
reviews.text: My subscription doesn’t expire for 4 weeks according to my Apple account. The app says I don’t have a subscription. I send several e mails over the last week. So far, nothing but crickets. No response whatsoever to my inquiries.

reviews.title: Don’t nag me to review your app
reviews.text: Don’t nag me to review your app

reviews.title: $100 Subscription Contains Ads
reviews.text:
Content aside (-4.7 bias from AllSides), which y’all probably know going into a subscription, the platform contains ads directly embedded in its articles on the app. Unsubscribing after less than 1 hour of use.

Edit: dropping star rating after attempting to interact with technical support for about 40min. Never got to a human and entered multiple loops with the helper bot.

reviews.title: App needs a rewrite
reviews.text: Great articles. Horrible app. If you see an article on Facebook you can't navigate easily to the article in the app. I tried the app search feature typing the exact name of the article and it didn't appear. I tried using the authors name and couldn't find it easily. The navigation and look up seems archaic.

reviews.title: The latest update breaks games
reviews.text: I can no longer share and complete a crossword with another person. This latest app update has completely broken this feature. Please fix as this was the main reason I subscribed to your app.

reviews.title: Subscription?
reviews.text:
You pay for a "subscription", and yet, the articles are littered with TEMU Ads. among many?
=  W R O N G ! ! !

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: They have become a mouthpiece for corporate neocon lies

reviews.title: Trash
reviews.text: I consume Media at a voracious speed. I tried The Atlantic because I was looking for different viewpoints. I am personally centrist politically, I do not align myself to a particular party, and I’m not a fan of the current administration and their policies and their foreign policies. But as I read these articles from Keegan and others, the vitriol, the inability to just write facts with maybe some subtle opinions is devoid in this magazine. I’m canceling my subscription, I’m deeply disappointed, I feel like I’m reading Fox News for the left and that wasn’t what I was told this magazine was nor what I think is really good reporting. So thank you but no thank you, and these toxic times we need great reporters doing great reporting not spewing vitreal to Gardner hard left readers.

reviews.title: Search!
reviews.text:
Wish I could search for articles. And wish that if my friend texts me an article it’ll open in the app and not safari (which never keeps me logged in)

It’s also difficult to share articles from the app

reviews.title: App is flawed
reviews.text: The app eats battery like nothing else. Uses twice as much battery compared to browser usage. Not sure if it’s from background refreshing or the excessive video ads.
